# Test-layout ratchet baseline. The rule is TST-3 in docs/RUST_GUIDELINES.md.
# Each line is "<path> <inline #[cfg(test)] module bodies> <test functions>";
# every test attribute counts (#[test], #[tokio::test], any #[path::test]).
# The baseline is exact: the check fails if a count differs from its line (grown
# or shrunk), if an unlisted file has inline tests, or if an entry is stale.
# Change a line only in the change that moves the tests.
#
# No debt left: an inline test in a production file now fails the check.
